prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high in early tests, but several round 3 successes (adoption new_flow, home new_flow) were under-predicted.
sign_in hint changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path redesign, and finish new_screen as each has only been tested once.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, finish copy, finish incentive, home wait_info, and sign_in copy, each having only 1 test.
home new_flow produced one winning test and one test with no clear effect, so evidence for a consistent effect is still thin.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Save Protection Reassurance: Add a cloud save active status badge and persistent account protection banner on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again; explicit cloud backup messaging addresses account persistence anxiety.)
1: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Guidance Tip Carousel: Add a photo selection tip carousel and hint text to the upload photos step explaining lighting and framing standards. (why: Support receives tickets reporting custom pet generation failures or incorrect appearances; explicit photo guidance reduces generation errors.)
2: [home, wait_info] Active Wait Status & Notification Option: Enable time estimates and desktop completion notification toggles on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting screen exhibits a high mean duration of 2336s and 86.4% conversion; providing progress transparency reduces drop-off from long generation times.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Spawn Location Placement Guidance: Update the home intro copy to specifically instruct users where their pet spawns on screen and how to drag it. (why: Support received multiple reports of 'pet does not show on desktop or app will not open' due to users missing the initial spawn location.)
4: [choose_path, notification] Story Step Progress Indicator: Enable step counter and progress bar indicators on the initial story screen. (why: Setting clear onboarding step expectations early reduces initial drop-off (currently 80.4% conversion on choose_path).)
